missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `lattice dispatch --storyId=B-f88e --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `lattice scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.

scope gap: description mentions "story-files-hash-material-drift.md states the storyFilesHash downgrade path is 'not a silent rebind... and not permission to rewrite stored hashes', while the story's own facts describe eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade as rewriting a verdict's materialDigest to the current value whenever storyFilesHash matches; the checklist does not state whether this existing rewrite behaviour itself is spec-compliant (e.g. an in-memory evaluation view vs. a literal persisted-record mutation) or whether CHK-002's fix should narrow more than just the colliding-identity case" but there is no corresponding checklist item and it is not excluded

scope gap: description mentions "red-evidence-subsystem-spec.md / repro-first-gate-enforce-execution-plan.md define a formal v2 RED-evidence chain (red_evidence_assert, registered target binding, GREEN predicate) as the trusted way to record RED reproductions; CHK-001 instead plans a plain shebang .mjs script registered only in lattice.config.json validate.commands (the older red-b2aa7 convention), and this story's own story_review already surfaces a 'missing_red_evidence' advisory noting no red-evidence.json record exists" but there is no corresponding checklist item and it is not excluded

scope feature review-run-binding-race.md establishes a precedent that 'the storyFilesHash drift-advisory downgrade must treat EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH ... as no-signal on BOTH the stored and the live side and fall through to strict materialHash', already implemented in delivery-check-hash.ts / evidence-freshness.ts / milestone-status.ts, but grep confirms review-escalation.ts (the file this story edits) has no EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH guard, and CHK-002 does not mention this edge case orphan-suspect: see decisions:review-run-binding-race.md is not covered by any CHK but is not explicitly excluded, please confirm
